parameters.query:
=SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.country, o.currency, o.amount, o.shipping_fee, o.payment_method,
       o.status AS order_status, o.refunded,
       s.status AS ship_status, s.estimated_delivery, s.delivered_date, s.claim_status,
       datediff(c.asof, CAST(s.delivered_date AS DATE)) AS days_since_delivery,
       CASE WHEN s.status = 'delivered' THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST(0, datediff(c.asof, s.estimated_delivery)) END AS days_late,
       p.return_window_days, p.delay_threshold_days, p.auto_limit, p.approval_limit,
       p.max_auto_actions_30d, p.refund_method, p.version AS policy_version,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workspace.agentic_support.returns r WHERE r.order_id = o.order_id) +
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workspace.agentic_support.refunds f WHERE f.order_id = o.order_id) AS prior_actions,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workspace.agentic_support.audit_log a WHERE a.customer_id = o.customer_id AND a.route = 'auto'
          AND a.decision = 'Executed' AND a.event_time >= date_sub(c.asof, 30)) AS auto_actions_30d,
       (SELECT CAST(config_value AS INT) FROM workspace.agentic_support.config WHERE config_key = 'risk_score_escalate') AS risk_score_escalate,
       (SELECT CAST(config_value AS INT) FROM workspace.agentic_support.config WHERE config_key = 'serial_refund_threshold') AS serial_refund_threshold,
       (SELECT CAST(config_value AS INT) FROM workspace.agentic_support.config WHERE config_key = 'damage_report_days') AS damage_report_days
FROM workspace.agentic_support.orders o
LEFT JOIN workspace.agentic_support.shipments s ON s.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN workspace.agentic_support.policies p ON p.country = o.country
CROSS JOIN (SELECT CAST(config_value AS DATE) AS asof FROM workspace.agentic_support.config WHERE config_key = 'as_of_date') c
WHERE o.order_id = '{{ $json.order_id }}'
  AND o.customer_id = '{{ $json.customer_id }}'

=UPDATE workspace.agentic_support.orders
SET status = 'cancelled',
    cancelled_at = current_timestamp(),
    cancel_reason_code = NULLIF('{{ ($('Trigger').first().json.reason_code || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}', ''),
    cancel_reason_text = NULLIF('{{ ($('Trigger').first().json.reason_text || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}', ''),
    cancelled_by = 'agent'
WHERE order_id = '{{ $('Trigger').first().json.order_id }}'
  AND customer_id = '{{ $('Trigger').first().json.customer_id }}'
  AND status IN ('payment_pending', 'packed')

=INSERT INTO workspace.agentic_support.audit_log
  (customer_id, order_id, agent, decision, amount, currency, route, approved_by, policy_version, reason)
VALUES (
  '{{ $('Trigger').first().json.customer_id }}',
  NULLIF('{{ $('Trigger').first().json.order_id }}', ''),
  'WatchMate Genie',
  'Executed',
  NULLIF({{ Number($('Decide').first().json.refund_amount) }}, 0),
  NULLIF('{{ $('Decide').first().json.currency }}', ''),
  NULLIF('{{ $('Decide').first().json.route }}', ''),
  NULL,
  NULLIF('{{ $('Decide').first().json.policy_version }}', ''),
  NULLIF('{{ $('Decide').first().json.reasons }}', '')
)

SELECT CONCAT('RF', LPAD(CAST(COALESCE(MAX(TRY_CAST(SUBSTRING(refund_id, 3) AS INT)), 0) + 1 AS STRING), 4, '0')) AS next_id
FROM workspace.agentic_support.refunds
WHERE refund_id RLIKE '^RF[0-9]{4}$'

=INSERT INTO workspace.agentic_support.refunds
  (refund_id, order_id, return_id, refund_type, amount, currency, method, status, route, approved_by, created_at)
SELECT
  '{{ $('Generate Refund ID').first().json.next_id }}',
  o.order_id,
  NULL,
  'cancel',
  {{ Number($('Decide').first().json.refund_amount) }},
  o.currency,
  IF(o.payment_method = 'cod', 'bank_upi', 'original_payment'),
  'completed',
  '{{ $('Decide').first().json.route }}',
  NULL,
  current_date()
FROM workspace.agentic_support.orders o
WHERE o.order_id = '{{ $('Trigger').first().json.order_id }}'

=UPDATE workspace.agentic_support.orders
SET refunded = 'yes'
WHERE order_id = '{{ $('Trigger').first().json.order_id }}'
  AND customer_id = '{{ $('Trigger').first().json.customer_id }}'

=SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.country, o.currency, o.amount,
       o.shipping_fee, o.payment_method, o.status AS order_status,
       o.refunded
FROM workspace.agentic_support.orders o
LEFT JOIN workspace.agentic_support.shipments s ON s.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_id = '{{ $json.order_id }}'
  AND o.customer_id = '{{ $json.customer_id }}'
